narrative.intro: Techflow is a federal contractor with $310M in contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Techflow has 3 awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $103M. Techflow’s obligations are up 26.6% year over year. Techflow has moved through a sequence of fiscal-year obligations that shows FY21 at $193M, FY22 at $247M, FY23 at $223M, FY24 at $271M, FY25 at $245M, and FY26 at $310M. The Department of Homeland Security is Techflow’s largest buyer this fiscal year with $310M in obligations. The General Services Administration is also a buyer of record with $347K in obligations. Electronic and Precision Equipment Repair and Maintenance is Techflow’s largest market by obligations at $310M. The fiscal-year totals are partial because the period covers FY2026 to date and the note clarifies that figures are contract obligations except where table values are total contract values.

sections.heading: How has Techflow's federal business trended?

sections.heading: Who are Techflow's top buyers and markets?
